tools.name: load_workspace_dependencies
tools.description: Get absolute paths to bundled Python and library directories, plus bundled Python distribution versions. Node.js and pnpm paths are included when the payload provides them. Python includes numpy, pandas, python-docx, python-pptx, openpyxl, Pillow, lxml, and XlsxWriter. Use these libraries for Office files unless the user or workspace instructions select another environment. When Node.js and pnpm paths are returned, run pnpm with that Node executable and pnpm script path. This does not change PATH or package-manager settings.

tools.name: ocr_image
tools.description: 对图片进行文字提取（OCR），仅返回图中文字内容。适用场景：提取截图/文档中的纯文字、读取表格数据、获取界面文字标签。不适用于理解图片整体含义或回答图片内容问题——那些请用 analyze_image。仅读取图片文字，不要当作看图失败的重试。

image_path.description: 图片文件路径。与 attachment_id 二选一。

attachment_id.description: 上传图片的附件 id（形如 "sha256:..."）。与 attachment_id 二选一。

engine.description: 识别引擎：auto(默认) 优先本地、local 仅本地、vlm 仅视觉模型。

tools.name: plugin_manager
tools.description: List plugins or bundles in the current profile, enable or disable them, install a bundle, or remove an installed bundle. Every action requires danger-full-access permission or approval for this call. Approval does not change the session permission mode. Changes affect every session in this profile. List first to obtain exact identifiers. Package installation can execute allowed build scripts. Live profiles apply changes immediately, including upgrades of installed packages; a change result that is not applied carries nextStep, which says what to do or tell the user. Unmet DSH version requirements (engines.dsh, else DSH peer dependencies) block installation and activation. Version exemptions risk crashes and data loss: warn the user and obtain explicit permission for the exact plugin and runtime versions before granting one.

action.description: Management operation.

target.description: Plugin entry id, bundle package name, or installation spec, according to action. For an Official catalog entry, pass list_bundles installTarget.spec to install_bundle.

enabled.description: Required for set operations; defaults to true for installation. For set_version_exemption, true grants and false revokes.

runtimeVersion.description: For set_version_exemption: exact DSH version from list_version_exemptions. Target must be the manifest package-name@version, not an alias or version range.

acceptRisk.description: For granting an exemption: true only after warning the user about possible crashes and data loss and receiving explicit permission for this exact plugin/runtime pair. General installation permission is not enough.

approvedBuilds.description: For install_bundle: pass names from pendingBuilds only after the user explicitly approves running their install scripts in the conversation. This grants persistent permission for this profile.

registry.description: For install_bundle: the npm registry URL asked first, when the user names one; otherwise the configured registry is asked, and its configured fallbacks while a registry is unreachable.

limit.description: List page size, from 1 to 100; defaults to 25.

tools.name: present
tools.description: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user. Hosts may show presented files only after your turn ends, so call it once the files are final. If the user needs to review files earlier, such as before a tool call that waits for their answer, link them in your message instead. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

files.description: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.

path.description: Path of an existing regular file. Relative paths use the Session working directory.

description.description: Brief description for the user.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

tools.name: read_image
tools.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. Large images are downscaled automatically; do not install image libraries or create thumbnails to inspect an image.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

tools.name: sample_colors
tools.description: 对图片进行主色调采样（纯本地计算，不消耗任何视觉模型额度）。可选 region 限定采样区域。返回最常见的若干颜色及其占比，适用于判断配色、主题或背景色。

image_path.description: 图片文件路径。与 attachment_id 二选一。

attachment_id.description: 上传图片的附件 id（形如 "sha256:..."）。与 image_path 二选一。

region.description: 限定采样区域，形如 "x1,y1,x2,y2"（同 zoom_image 语义，可为分数）。

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

title.description: Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes.

prompt.description: Instruction delivered at each occurrence.

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

target.description: this_session delivers to this session; new_once delivers to the same new session every time, opened at the first delivery; new opens a different new session for every delivery. New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.

tools.name: schedule_edit
tools.description: Update, pause, resume, or delete one scheduled task by id. Deleting does not retract queued messages.

id.description: Task id.

action.description: update applies the provided fields, at least one; delete removes the task.

title.description: Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes.

prompt.description: New instruction delivered at each occurrence.

rrule.description: New recurrence in the schedule_create rrule format.

target.description: Omit to retain the destination and its creation settings. Providing target replaces them; new_once reserves a different Session. New targets capture this Session's working directory and preset. Choices are the same as schedule_create.

active.description: false pauses the task; true resumes only if its timing has a future occurrence. Otherwise provide a new rrule.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: updatedAt from the latest result that returned this task; if the task changed after that result, the result is schedule_conflict and nothing changes.

tools.name: schedule_list
tools.description: List scheduled tasks, including tasks created from other sessions. Active tasks come first, ordered by scheduledAt.

active.description: true for active tasks only; false for paused and ended tasks only; omitted for all tasks.

limit.description: Page size from 1 to 500; defaults to 100.

offset.description: Number of tasks to skip; defaults to 0.

tools.name: schedule_view
tools.description: View one scheduled task by id.

id.description: Task id.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send one message to another Team member. A running target receives it at the nearest step boundary; an inactive target starts or resumes a turn.

target.description: Member target returned by spawn_teammate or list_agents, including lead.

tools.name: show_image
tools.description: 把图片展示给用户查看（仅展示，不分析）。可一次展示多张（image_paths，横向并排）。本地图片、附件或 generate_image 生成的图片均可。注意：本工具只负责在对话中显示图片让用户看到，不会分析图片内容。如需理解图片内容、回答图片相关问题，请使用 analyze_image 工具。

image_path.description: 单张图片文件路径。与 attachment_id 二选一；展示多张请改用 image_paths。

attachment_id.description: 上传图片的附件 id（形如 "sha256:..."）。与 image_path 二选一。

image_paths.description: 一次展示多张图片的路径数组（最多 8 张，横向并排）。非空时优先于 image_path/attachment_id。

tools.name: show_video
tools.description: 把视频展示给用户查看（仅展示，不分析）。传入本地视频文件路径，会在对话中渲染一个播放器。注意：本工具只负责显示视频，不会分析视频内容；如需理解视频内容请使用 analyze_media 工具。

video_path.description: 视频文件路径（绝对路径或相对当前工作目录）。

tools.name: skill
tools.description: Load the full instructions for a skill. Call it before acting on a task that names or clearly matches a skill in the session skill catalog.

name.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

tools.name: spawn_teammate
tools.description: Create one named, durable teammate. Only the Team Lead may call this tool.

name.description: Unique lower-kebab-case teammate name.

description.description: Short description of the delegated responsibility.

prompt.description: Complete initial task for the teammate.

context.description: fresh starts without Lead history; fork inherits completed Lead turns. Defaults to fresh.

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes. Supply `provider` and `model` together. Omitted values use child defaults, falling back to compatible parent values. When the effective route changes, an omitted `reasoning_effort` uses the model's default.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.

tools.name: subagent_fork
tools.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

tools.name: team_task_create
tools.description: Create one unowned pending task on the shared Team task board.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

package com.zhuli.core

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.ComponentName
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.os.PowerManager
import android.provider.Settings
import android.util.Log

object StartupGuard {

    private const val TAG = "zhuli.keepalive"

    /** 电池优化豁免状态：true=已豁免（省电不会轻易掐死），false=仍被优化。 */
    fun batteryExempt(ctx: Context): Boolean {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.M) return true
        val pm = ctx.getSystemService(Context.POWER_SERVICE) as? PowerManager ?: return true
        return try { pm.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations(ctx.packageName) } catch (t: Throwable) { false }
    }

    /** 厂商自带「自启动/后台管理」入口候选，按机型优先级排列（努比亚 MyOS 在前）。 */
    private fun autoStartIntents(): List<Intent> = listOf(
        // 努比亚/ZTE：应用省电管理（后台运行、自启动开关所在页）
        Intent("com.zte.powersavemode.intent.action.AppManagerActivity"),
        // 努比亚/ZTE：应用手动省电优化（同族页，部分版本才暴露）
        Intent("com.zte.powersavemode.intent.action.AppManualOptimizeActivity"),
        // 省电模式总入口（兜底，用户可自己往下翻）
        Intent("com.zte.powersavemode.intent.action.SettingsActivity")
    )

    /** 打开系统应用详情页（所有 ROM 都有，最可靠的兜底）。 */
    fun openAppDetails(ctx: Context): Boolean = tryStart(
        ctx,
        Intent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS, Uri.parse("package:${ctx.packageName}"))
    )

    /** 请求电池优化豁免；优先直达弹窗，不行退到列表页，再不行退应用详情。 */
    fun openBatterySettings(ctx: Context): String { ... }

    /** 打开厂商自启动管理；返回命中的动作名，全失败则回退应用详情。 */
    fun openAutoStart(ctx: Context): String { ... }

    private fun tryStart(ctx: Context, i: Intent): Boolean {
        i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
        return try { ctx.startActivity(i); true } catch (t: Throwable) { Log.w(TAG, ...); false }
    }
}

{"file_path":"D:\ai\gongzuo\新建文件夹\zhuli\zhuli-assistant-step2-build\app\src\main\java\com\zhuli\app\MainActivity.kt","new_string":"    /**
     * 第 13 步 B4 · 保活白名单引导。
     *
     * 为什么必须做：真机实证 `adb reboot` 后 MyOS 不投递 BOOT_COMPLETED，闹钟不会自动重排；
     * 只有把 App 加进系统自启动白名单 + 电池豁免，才能开机就恢复提醒。
     * 口径：全部跳手机自带设置页，不申请特殊权限、不做后台拉活。
     */
    private fun openKeepAliveGuide() {
        val lines = StartupGuard.statusLines(this)
        val msg = buildString {
            appendLine("重启后提醒要能自己活过来，需要两个系统开关：")
            appendLine()
            for ((k, v) in lines) appendLine("· $k：$v")
            appendLine()
            append("两项都是系统级开关，App 无法代勾，只能带你到对应的官方设置页。")
        }
        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle("保活白名单引导")
            .setMessage(msg.trim())
            .setPositiveButton("自启动管理") { _, _ ->
                val r = StartupGuard.openAutoStart(this)
                appendLine("[系统] 自启动入口：${r.via}")
                toast(r.via)
            }
            .setNeutralButton("电池豁免") { _, _ ->
                val r = StartupGuard.openBatterySettings(this)
                appendLine("[系统] 电池设置：${r.via}")
                toast(r.via)
            }
            .setNegativeButton("应用详情") { _, _ ->
                StartupGuard.openAppDetails(this)
            }
            .show()
    }

Interesting — it landed on `com.android.settings/.applications.InstalledAppDetails` (app details), NOT the ZTE page. That means the explicit component attempt failed and it fell through to app details fallback? But wait, the action `AppManagerActivity` resolved fine earlier.

Hmm, actually maybe the first candidate (explicit component `com.zte.powersavemode/.appspowersave.AppManagerActivity`) started, but... focus is InstalledAppDetails. That suggests all ZTE candidates failed → fell back to openAppDetails.

Why would explicit component fail? Possibly because starting an Activity from another package requires it to be exported=true. If `AppManagerActivity` isn't exported, startActivity throws SecurityException → caught → next candidate. And all three ZTE ones may be non-exported (they're internal, likely launched by their own launcher).

But `cmd package resolve-activity` earlier showed them resolvable — resolution doesn't guarantee export.

Also earlier when I tried `am start -a com.zte.powersavemode.intent.action.AppManagerActivity` from adb shell (uid 2000), it... actually that command got blocked by WAF so we never saw result.

So: from an app context, these ZTE internals are likely not accessible. Hence fallback to app details — which is actually the honest, working outcome.

{"file_path":"D:\ai\gongzuo\新建文件夹\zhuli\zhuli-assistant-step2\README.md","new_string":"## 第 13 步 B4 怎么跑（保活白名单引导）

**为什么做**：真机实证 `adb reboot` 后 MyOS 不向本应用投递 BOOT_COMPLETED，闹钟不会自动重排；
打开 App 会由 `sweepAsync → scan` 兜底重建，但要「开机就自己活过来」，只能靠系统级的
**自启动白名单 + 电池优化豁免**。这是 OEM 行为，App 无法用代码代替，只能引导。

```
「白名单引导」按钮 → 面板（真实状态 + 三条路）
      ├ 电池豁免：PowerManager.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations 实时查状态
      │            → ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS 直连系统弹窗（一次点击）
      │            → 退 ACTION_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATION_SETTINGS 列表页
      ├ 复制指引：按 Build.MANUFACTURER 给对应机型的路径文案，写进剪贴板
      └ 应用详情：ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS（所有 ROM 必有，最终兜底）
```

**真机摸底的硬结论（NX733J / MyOS Android 16）**：
厂商省电页 `com.zte.powersavemode` 的 `AppManagerActivity` / `SettingsActivity` /
`PowerSaveModeActivity` 全部受 **`zte.permission.LAUNCH_POWER_SAVER_ACTIVITY`** 签名级权限保护——
**第三方应用与 adb shell 都抛 SecurityException，不可达**。所以代码里**不保留**这些候选：
跳了也只会白弹失败，不如直接给能用的路。

**原则**：
- 能查的才查（电池豁免有公开 API 就显示真状态）；**自启动无公开 API，一律标「需手动确认」，绝不假绿勾**；
- 不装流氓软件：不引入保活库、不常驻前台、不申请自启动私有权限。

## 后续步骤接口（预留字段）","old_string":"## 后续步骤接口（预留字段）"}

### 3.7 第 13 步 B4（保活白名单引导，✅ 真机验收 · 提前做）

**由头**：第 5 步重启实证——MyOS 不投递 BOOT_COMPLETED，开机闹钟不自动恢复；
加系统白名单才能「开机就活」。这是 OEM 行为，App 只能引导、不能代替。

**代码**：新增 `StartupGuard.kt`；壳加「白名单引导」按钮 + 面板；manifest 加
`REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS`（普通权限）。

**真机验收（NX733J）**：

| 项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 状态检测 | ✅ 电池优化实时真实取值（当前 ❌ 仍受限）；自启动诚实标「需手动确认」，不假绿勾 |
| 电池豁免 | ✅ 直达系统弹窗（`.fuelgauge.RequestIgnoreBatteryOptimizations`）「允许/拒绝」一次点击完成 |
| 应用详情兜底 | ✅ 落到 `.applications.InstalledAppDetails` |
| 复制指引 | ✅ 剪贴板 + 聊天区回执，按 `Build.MANUFACTURER` 给对应机型路径 |
| 越权克制 | ✅ 验证时点「拒绝」退出，授权留给用户本人 |

**摸底硬结论（省得后人再试）**：
`com.zte.powersavemode` 的 `AppManagerActivity` / `SettingsActivity` / `PowerSaveModeActivity`
全部受 **`zte.permission.LAUNCH_POWER_SAVER_ACTIVITY`** 签名级权限保护，
`am start` 报 `SecurityException: Permission Denial ... requires zte.permission...`，
**第三方与 shell 都进不去**。所以代码不保留这些候选，只留三条真路。
另记：`cmd package resolve-activity` 能解析 ≠ 能启动（解析只看 filter，签名权限另算）。","old_string":"踩坑：需求文档原例「午饭 32」裸数字在单位/语境双重识别下漏抽 —— `AMOUNT_CTX`

![引导面板](D:/ai/gongzuo/新建文件夹/zhuli/zhuli-assistant-step2-build/screenshots/step13-keepalive-guide.png)

### 做成了什么

新增 [StartupGuard.kt](zhuli/zhuli-assistant-step2/core/StartupGuard.kt)，壳里加「白名单引导」按钮。面板给出**真实状态 + 三条真能用**的路：

| 能力 | 实现 | 真机结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 电池优化状态 | `PowerManager.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations` | ✅ 实时显示「❌ 仍受限」，不是写死的 |
| 电池豁免 | 直连 `ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS` | ✅ 秒开系统弹窗「允许/拒绝」，一次点击搞定 |
| 应用详情 | `ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS` | ✅ 兜底可达 |
| 自启动 | 无公开 API/通用入口 | ⚠️ 诚实标「需手动确认」，**绝不假绿勾** |
| 手动指引 | 按 `Build.MANUFACTURER` 给机型专属路径，一键复制 | ✅ 剪贴板 + 聊天区回执 |

### 一个关键摸底结论（省得以后白折腾）

厂商省电页 `com.zte.powersavemode` 的 `AppManagerActivity` / `SettingsActivity` / `PowerSaveModeActivity` **全部被 `zte.permission.LAUNCH_POWER_SAVER_ACTIVITY` 签名级权限锁死**：

```
SecurityException: Permission Denial: starting Intent ... 
requires zte.permission.LAUNCH_POWER_SAVER_ACTIVITY
```

第三方应用和 adb shell **都进不去**。所以代码里**不保留**这些候选——跳了只会白弹失败。这也印证了「`resolve-activity` 能解析 ≠ 能启动」这个坑。

### 顺手修掉的一个真问题

之前文档写「bundled OCR 只 +2MB」是**错的**：它把 4 个 ABI 的原生库全打进 APK，实际 45MB（x86/x86_64 白占 22MB）。已加 `abiFilters` 只留 arm，**22.9MB**，装机 `primaryCpuAbi=arm64-v8a`，账本/对话功能冒烟无回归。三份文档里的失真说法全部改正并复查零残留。

### 你需要手动做的一件事（App 替不了）

打开 App →「白名单引导」→ 点「电池豁免」→ 允许；再点「复制指引」按提示去自启动白名单里勾上「zhuli助理」。设好之后重启手机，提醒就能自己活过来——这条链路现在有面板和文案兜着，不用记。

下一步就剩**第 8 步语音链路**了，你发令本鱼就接着干。

content.text: 下一步
下一步

User says "下一步" — next step. That's 第 8 步: 语音链路 (voice: ASR transcription into the same pipeline).

Let me plan:
- Share menu receives audio/* (voice messages, m4a/amr/ogg/mp3/wav)
- Transcribe to text — but on-device? Sensitive? Voice messages may contain sensitive content. Requirement says 语音消息 → ASR 转写后进同一条流水线.
- Constraint from earlier: 敏感不出机 → for OCR we used on-device. For ASR, on-device options:
  - Android's built-in `SpeechRecognizer` (requires audio playback + mic, not suitable for shared audio files directly — it listens to mic, and can't easily feed a file)
  - ML Kit doesn't have ASR.
  - MediaPipe / Whisper on-device (needs model ~40-75MB, and integrating whisper.cpp is heavy without NDK build).
  - sherpa-onnx — needs native lib.

Realistic approach with "复用手机已有能力": Android has `android.speech.SpeechRecognizer` which accepts `EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE` (Parcelable URI) — from API 33+? Actually `RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE` exists and some implementations support a file URI (AudioSource). It's available since API 31 (EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE added in API 33? let me recall: `RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE` was added in API 33 (Tiramisu)). It expects a `ParcelFileDescriptor` extra? Actually the extra is "android.speech.extra.AUDIO_SOURCE" of type Parcelable (ParcelFileDescriptor). And EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE_CHANNEL_COUNT etc.

However, the system SpeechRecognizer on this ROM (MyOS) likely requires Google app; may not work offline and may be Chinese-capable via online service — which conflicts with 敏感不出机.

Alternative honest approach: 
1. Wire the audio entry (manifest audio/*, ShareReceiverActivity audio branch) 
2. Implement ASR behind a pluggable interface: default = 系统语音识别 (SpeechRecognizer with EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE) on device if available; fallback = 提示"需要配置云端 ASR" and store placeholder? 

Hmm. Given the project's privacy rule and the "复用手机能力" preference, the pragmatic v1:
- Accept audio share, store entry with duration/size metadata
- Try on-device recognition via `SpeechRecognizer` + `EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE` (API 33+). If unavailable/fails → mark honestly "语音未转写（本机识别不可用）" and keep the file path for later (第 9 步云兜底 with user consent).
- Transcribed text then flows into ExtractPipeline → same pipeline (classification, deadline, amount, ledger).

But there's a catch: SpeechRecognizer typically requires the app to have RECORD_AUDIO permission. When using EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE (file), some implementations still need RECORD_AUDIO. And it may show UI. We can use it headless-ish with RecognitionListener.

Given constraints and lack of ability to verify audio recognition on device (uncertain), the honest deliverable:
- Audio entry + capture metadata
- ASR attempt via system recognizer with file source, guarded
- Fallback to "待转写" state with clear note + 保留文件路径（供第 9 步云 ASR，用户同意后）
- Pipeline integration for transcribed text
- UI: 「语音转写」按钮 for pending audio? Or auto.

This is getting complex. Let me think about what's verifiable: I can generate a test audio file? Creating speech audio without TTS is hard. I could use `adb shell` to synthesize? No TTS engine guaranteed. Could use the phone's TTS (`com.google.android.tts` may exist) to generate an audio file? Not easily.

Actually — I could test with any audio file to verify the *entry path* (share → store → attempt ASR → honest fallback). The ASR success path may not be verifiable without real speech.

Better plan: implement with a clear architecture, verify what's verifiable:
1. audio/* share → 入库占位 + 元数据
2. 尝试系统 ASR（文件源）→ 成功则文本走流水线；失败则标「未转写」并保留路径
3. 真机验证：分享一个音频文件 → 条目入库、状态字段正确、不崩

Generate a test audio: I can create a WAV with silence/tone via PowerShell/System.Drawing? No. Could generate WAV bytes with a script (Python available? yes python 3.14). Generate a WAV with a sine tone — verifiable as "audio file" for the entry path; ASR will produce nothing useful but shouldn't crash.

Actually better: use Python to synthesize speech? No TTS lib. But Windows has SAPI via PowerShell! `Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech; $sp = New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer; $sp.SetOutputToWaveFile('...'); $sp.Speak('明天下午三点提醒我开会')`. Also `com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox` exists — but apparently doesn't register a RecognitionService on this ROM (or it's disabled).

So `SpeechRecognizer.isRecognitionAvailable()` returned false even though dev.davidv.translator exists? Because isRecognitionAvailable checks if the service is enabled/available... Actually it should return true. Hmm, maybe the translator app's service isn't a "default" recognition service, but isRecognitionAvailable typically just checks resolveActivity(SERVICE_INTERFACE).

Wait — SpeechRecognizer.isRecognitionAvailable() checks:
```java
return context.getPackageManager().queryIntentServices(new Intent(RecognitionService.SERVICE_INTERFACE), PackageManager.MATCH_DEFAULT_ONLY or 0).isEmpty() == false
```
Actually it historically checks *activities* for RecognitionService? Let me recall: In AOSP:
```java
public static boolean isRecognitionAvailable(final Context context) {
    final List<ResolveInfo> list = context.getPackageManager().queryIntentServices(
            new Intent(RecognitionService.SERVICE_INTERFACE), 0);
    return list != null && list.size() != 0;
}
```
So it should return true given the translator service exists.

But my code reported "本机没有可用的语音识别服务" — meaning `available()` returned false. Possibly:
1. The translator app is installed for a different user? It's uid 10640, seems user 0.
2. `SpeechRecognizer.isRecognitionAvailable` in newer Android might require the service to be the *default* one — Android 14+ may restrict to default recognition service set by the user (there's `Settings.Secure.voice_recognition_service` which returned empty!).

On Android 14+, `isRecognitionAvailable` may check `isOnDeviceRecognitionAvailable` or the default service. Since `voice_recognition_service` is empty, maybe it fails.

Hmm, but our app could still try createSpeechRecognizer which then binds... If no default, ERROR_CLIENT maybe.

Two options:
A) Test again — maybe error is because Build.VERSION check? No, API 36 (Android 16) >= 33.

Let me add diagnostics: log the actual reason. But simpler: change strategy — instead of relying on isRecognitionAvailable, try `SpeechRecognizer.createSpeechRecognizer()` + `createOnDeviceSpeechRecognizer()` and see.

Actually `createOnDeviceSpeechRecognizer` requires an on-device recognition service (Android 12+). The translator app might support on-device? Unclear.

Better: test on device by writing a tiny probe? Too heavy.

Pragmatic path: modify `available()` to also try `createOnDeviceSpeechRecognizer` availability, and just attempt recognition regardless of isRecognitionAvailable (let it fail with a real error), so we get a truthful message instead of a premature "no service" guess.

So change:
- remove the `isRecognitionAvailable` early return; instead attempt and let onError give the reason. Keep a check but treat as hint only.

Let me restructure: `transcribeAsync` → if API<33 → fail; else attempt. In runRecognition, if createSpeechRecognizer throws → error.

That will produce a real error message like "识别失败：客户端错误" or actually work with the translator service.

Let me make that change, rebuild, retest. If translator service works, we get real transcription!

Also note: user might have that translator installed for other purposes; using it is a side effect but it IS a RecognitionService on the phone (复用手机已有能力).

Let me edit VoiceNote: replace the available() gate with a softer attempt.

Also add: prefer on-device recognizer when available:
```kotlin
recognizer = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 31) runCatching { SpeechRecognizer.createOnDeviceSpeechRecognizer(ctx) }.getOrNull() ?: SpeechRecognizer.createSpeechRecognizer(ctx) else ...
```
Hmm, createOnDeviceSpeechRecognizer must be called from main thread (we are). It may throw. Let me just try regular first, and if error, no fallback to keep it simple.

Let me change `available()` usage: keep function but only for UI hint; in transcribeAsync, don't hard-block.

Edit now.

      （EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE 喂 ParcelFileDescriptor，不用麦克风、不弹录音 UI）
      ↓ 先试系统默认 → 再逐个试本机注册的 RecognitionService（createSpeechRecognizer(ctx, ComponentName)）

      ↓ 本地全失败时

## 🔄 第 8 步 · 语音链路（v0.9-voice）

### 做了什么

```
分享语音 → 秒回执 → 复制进私有目录 → 解析时长
        → 系统识别服务转写（默认 + 逐个注册服务 + 显式 ComponentName）
        → 成功：文本进同一条流水线（分类/期限/金额）+ 入账，音频即删
        → 失败：诚实落库 + 保留音频；若你勾了「允许语音上云」则走云端兜底
```

新增 [VoiceNote.kt](zhuli/zhuli-assistant-step2/core/VoiceNote.kt)，分享入口加 `audio/*` 分支，云设置面板加「允许语音上云」勾选（**默认关**，语音可能敏感）。

### 真机验证通过的部分

| 项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 语音进分享目标 | ✅ 秒回执「已收下语音，正在本机转写…」 |
| 音频私有化 + 时长 | ✅ 复制进 `files/zhuli_media/a<N>.wav`，3 秒的音频读出 3s |
| 本地识别多候选 | ✅ 默认 → 逐个注册服务 → 显式点名，全试遍不崩 |
| 诚实降级 | ✅ 落库：`[语音（3s）] 未转写：本机所有语音识别服务都不可用（…可在云设置里开启「允许语音上云」）` |
| 音频保留 | ✅ 路径记在库里，等重试 |

{"content":"# 会话原始存档说明

这里是 2026-11-19 那一整轮开发会话的原始记录，给「明天的你 / 另一台电脑」用。

## 文件

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `session-2026-11-19.jsonl` | **解压后的完整原始记录**（约 10MB / 2500+ 条）。含用户消息、助手正文、推理过程（reasoning）、工具调用与返回、任务状态等全部字段，一行一条 JSON |
| `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` | 从 DSH 会话目录直接拷来的**原始压缩档**（约 3MB），保真备份 |
| `export_session.js` | 导出脚本，可重跑（见下） |

## 可读的对话稿在上级目录

`../会话记录_2026-11-19.md` —— 已按「用户 / 助手」排好序，附精简工具流水，
过滤掉了系统注入消息（AGENTS.md 提醒、技能清单等 36 条噪声）。

## 怎么再导出一次（换成别的电脑时）

原始档是**多帧拼接的 zstd**（每帧自带 magic `28 B5 2F FD`），**不能整体解压**，
脚本里已按 magic 切帧再逐帧解。重跑：

```bash
node export_session.js <某个 session.v4.jsonl.zstd> <输出前缀>
# 产出 <输出前缀>.md（人读）与 <输出前缀>.jsonl（原始）
```

`.jsonl` 的常用字段（写脚本时照着取）：

- 顶层：`type` / `seq` / `time`（毫秒）/ `data`
- `user/message` → `data.content[]`（`{type:"text",text}`）+ `data.source.kind`（`user` 才是真人说的）
- `assistant/message` → `data.message.content[]`，元素类型有 `reasoning`（思考过程）、`text`（正文）、`tool-call`
- `tool/call` → `data.name` + `data.arguments`（JSON 字符串）
- `tool/result` → 对应 `callId` 的返回内容

## 会话在哪找（本机路径）

```
C:\Users\a\.dsh\sessions\--D-ai-gongzuo-~65B0~5EFA~6587~4EF6~5939--\
  session-72be1ce8-d692-4b5a-bdb5-474fa147e5ec\session.v4.jsonl.zstd
```

> 目录名是工作区路径的编码形式（`新建文件夹` → `~65B0~5EFA~6587~4EF6~5939`）。
> 换电脑后这个目录不存在，所以原始档已经拷进来，不必回头找。

## 注意

导出的时间点是 **11-19 22:29**，之后产生的对话（包括「导出会话」这轮本身）不在档内；
需要完整版就在收工时重跑一次脚本。
